body:
The text file you shared indicates that this is not intended to be an open source (ish) license; it is solely for your own organizational use and not other licensors (given the definition and use of "VGT" throughout); and I see no evidence of its use in the wild beyond your own personal projects. 

Additionally, the license text includes the following note at the top (_emphasis added_):

> Notice on Status: This text is an independently drafted license intended for use by VisionGaiaTechnology. It implements a strong copyleft and network-copyleft model and additionally contains an express restriction on military and intelligence use. Because of this field-of-use restriction, it is not intended to be an OSI-certified open-source license. _Before production rollout, a final review by legal counsel specializing in IT, copyright, and software licensing law is recommended._

which strongly suggests to me that this license is not in final form.

In any case, this does not appear to align with the license inclusion guidelines and I am not in favor of its inclusion on the SPDX license list.
